class Base; def label; 'base'; end; end
class Child < Base; end
bound = Child.new.public_method(:label)
raise 'wrong executed implementation' unless bound.call == 'base'
bound.owner.name + '#label'

class Base; def self.label; 'base'; end; end
class Child < Base; end
bound = Child.public_method(:label)
raise 'wrong executed implementation' unless bound.call == 'base'
bound.owner.to_s.sub(/\A#<Class:(.*)>\z/, '\1') + '.label'

class Parcel; private; def label; 'private'; end; end
begin
  Parcel.new.label
  'unexpected public call'
rescue NoMethodError => error
  raise unless error.name == :label
  nil
end

module Defaults; def label; 'default'; end; end
module Feature; include Defaults; def render; [label, method(:label).owner.name + '#label']; end; end
class Host; include Feature; def label; 'host'; end; end
value, owner = Host.new.render
raise 'wrong internal dispatch' unless value == 'host'
[owner]

module Defaults; def label; 'default'; end; end
